one_liner: Cloud CPaaS for programmable messaging, voice, email (SendGrid), WhatsApp and related customer engagement APIs.
access_notes: Sign up for a Twilio account (free 30‑day trial); create API Keys or register an OAuth app to obtain tokens.
mcp_notes: Hosted Twilio MCP server (Public Beta) at mcp.twilio.com/docs.
blocker_notes: Paid plan required to move beyond time‑boxed free units and trial restrictions.

evidence.quote: To authenticate requests to the Twilio APIs, Twilio supports HTTP Basic authentication. Use your API key SID as the username and your API key secret as the password.
OAuth 2.0 is an industry‑standard authorization protocol… Twilio supports two OAuth 2.0 grant types: Client Credentials and Authorization Code.
When you create a Twilio account, you start with a free 30‑day trial… You can sign up for a Twilio free trial account without a credit card.
Twilio OpenAPI 3.0 specification files allow you to integrate the Twilio API with a wide variety of community tools.
Twilio MCP… gives AI coding agents direct, structured access to Twilio’s full API surface… The server is hosted by Twilio at ‘mcp.twilio.com/docs’.

_trail.quote: "No installation required: The server is hosted by Twilio at `mcp.twilio.com/docs`—point your IDE at the URL."
